subject: CONVERT function
notes: Verdict unchanged; supplies the missing spec-derived test. The rule states an EQUIVALENCE, so the test asserts it directly - the long and short spellings must give identical results - rather than pinning one answer, and it does so in BOTH positions the words appear in per 15.19.2 (source-format AND destination-format), plus the NATIONAL/NAT half.
